stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出深部腦刺激手術的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Deep brain stimulation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：帕金森病、原發性顫抖與肌張力不全的立體定位電極植入：靶點（STN／GPi／VIM）規劃、微電極記錄、術中測試與脈衝產生器程控。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Stereotactic lead implantation for Parkinson's disease, essential tremor and dystonia: target planning (STN/GPi/VIM), microelectrode recording, intra-operative testing and pulse-generator programming.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
記錄的核團邊界與影像一致。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Recorded borders agree with imaging.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
記錄的核團邊界與影像一致。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Recorded borders agree with imaging.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 影像顯示電極位置與測試位置一致。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
靶點與軌跡經雙人核對並記錄。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Imaging shows the lead where it was tested.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Target and trajectory double-checked and recorded.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 配準誤差在容許範圍。
同意書與查核表完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
記錄的核團邊界與影像一致。
optionsEn: Registration error within tolerance.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Recorded borders agree with imaging.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依深部腦刺激手術的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Deep brain stimulation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 導引管位置經 X 光／O-arm 確認。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
配準誤差在容許範圍。
optionsEn: Cannula position confirmed on fluoroscopy/O-arm.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Registration error within tolerance.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 深部腦刺激手術的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Deep brain stimulation.

steps.title: 靶點規劃與影像融合
steps.objective: 在 MRI／CT 融合影像上標定 STN、GPi 或 VIM 並規劃安全軌跡。
steps.objectiveEn: Define STN, GPi or VIM on fused MRI/CT and plan a safe trajectory.
steps.instruction: 以 AC-PC 座標（STN 約 x±12、y−3、z−4 mm）為起點，依 T2／SWI 直接可視化微調；軌跡避開腦室、腦溝血管與尾狀核。
steps.instructionEn: Start from AC–PC coordinates (STN about x±12, y−3, z−4 mm), refine by direct T2/SWI visualisation; keep the trajectory clear of ventricles, sulcal vessels and the caudate.
steps.observation: 輸出入點、靶點座標、弧角與環角並雙人核對。
steps.observationEn: Export entry, target coordinates, arc and ring angles; two-person verification.
steps.failure: 座標錯誤或頭架移位會導致全部後續步驟失效；任何疑慮即重新掃描。
steps.failureEn: A coordinate error or frame shift invalidates every later step; rescan on any doubt.
steps.check: 靶點與軌跡經雙人核對並記錄。
steps.checkEn: Target and trajectory double-checked and recorded.

knowledge.title: 靶點選擇
knowledge.text: STN 適合動作遲緩與減藥、GPi 適合異動症與認知顧慮、VIM 適合單純顫抖。
knowledge.textEn: STN suits bradykinesia and medication reduction, GPi dyskinesia and cognitive concerns, VIM pure tremor.

knowledge.title: 直接與間接定位
knowledge.text: 間接以 AC-PC 圖譜推算，直接以高場 MRI 看見核團；兩者互相驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Indirect uses AC–PC atlas offsets; direct visualises the nucleus on high-field MRI; each validates the other.

quiz.question: 「靶點規劃與影像融合」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Target planning and image fusion'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
靶點與軌跡經雙人核對並記錄。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Target and trajectory double-checked and recorded.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 頭架安裝與配準
steps.objective: 安裝立體定位頭架並完成影像配準。
steps.objectiveEn: Mount the stereotactic frame and register the imaging.
steps.instruction: 局部麻醉下固定頭架，使平行於 AC-PC 面；CT 掃描後與規劃 MRI 融合，配準誤差 < 1 mm。
steps.instructionEn: Fix the frame under local anaesthesia parallel to the AC–PC plane; CT after mounting and fuse with the planning MRI, registration error < 1 mm.
steps.observation: 記錄配準誤差與基準點。
steps.observationEn: Record registration error and fiducials.
steps.failure: 誤差 > 1.5 mm 代表頭架鬆動或影像變形，必須重做。
steps.failureEn: Error > 1.5 mm indicates frame slippage or image distortion; redo.
steps.check: 配準誤差在容許範圍。
steps.checkEn: Registration error within tolerance.

knowledge.title: 無框架與機器人
knowledge.text: 骨錨基準與機器人臂可達到相近精度，仍需配準驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Bone fiducials and robotic arms achieve similar accuracy but still require registration checks.

quiz.question: 「頭架安裝與配準」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Frame placement and registration'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
配準誤差在容許範圍。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Registration error within tolerance.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 鑽孔、硬腦膜開啟與導管置入
steps.titleEn: Burr hole, dural opening and guide placement
steps.objective: 在入點鑽孔並置入導引管至靶點上方。
steps.objectiveEn: Drill the burr hole at the entry and advance the guide cannula to above the target.
steps.instruction: 14 mm 鑽孔，電燒硬腦膜後以纖維蛋白膠封閉減少腦脊液流失與腦移位；導引管停在靶點上方 10–25 mm。
steps.instructionEn: 14 mm burr hole; after dural coagulation seal with fibrin glue to limit CSF loss and brain shift; stop the cannula 10–25 mm above target.
steps.observation: 觀察腦脊液流失量與皮質血管。
steps.observationEn: Note CSF loss and cortical vessels.
steps.failure: 大量腦脊液流失造成腦移位，使規劃座標不再正確。
steps.failureEn: Excess CSF loss causes brain shift, invalidating planned coordinates.
steps.check: 導引管位置經 X 光／O-arm 確認。
steps.checkEn: Cannula position confirmed on fluoroscopy/O-arm.

knowledge.title: 腦移位
knowledge.text: 開顱後數毫米的位移是術中記錄與測試存在的理由。
knowledge.textEn: Millimetres of shift after opening are the reason intra-operative recording and testing exist.

quiz.question: 「鑽孔、硬腦膜開啟與導管置入」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Burr hole, dural opening and guide placement'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
導引管位置經 X 光／O-arm 確認。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Cannula position confirmed on fluoroscopy/O-arm.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 微電極記錄（MER）
steps.objective: 以 MER 辨識靶核的電生理邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the electrophysiological borders of the target nucleus by MER.
steps.instruction: 每 0.5–1 mm 推進，聽辨 STN 的高頻不規則放電與背景噪音升高、下方黑質網狀部的規則高頻放電；記錄進出核團深度。
steps.instructionEn: Advance in 0.5–1 mm steps; recognise the irregular high-frequency bursts and raised background of STN and the regular tonic firing of SNr below; record entry and exit depths.
steps.observation: 繪製各軌道的核團長度（STN 通常 ≥ 4–5 mm）。
steps.observationEn: Plot nucleus length per track (STN usually ≥ 4–5 mm).
steps.failure: 核團長度過短代表軌道偏離，應選擇其他軌道或調整。
steps.failureEn: A short span means the track is off-centre; choose another track or adjust.
steps.check: 記錄的核團邊界與影像一致。
steps.checkEn: Recorded borders agree with imaging.

knowledge.title: 清醒與全麻
knowledge.text: 全麻下 MER 訊號減弱，部分中心改以術中影像取代。
knowledge.textEn: Under general anaesthesia MER signal diminishes; some centres rely on intra-operative imaging instead.

quiz.question: 「微電極記錄（MER）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Microelectrode recording'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
靶點與軌跡經雙人核對並記錄。
記錄的核團邊界與影像一致。
系統阻抗正常、程式已儲存。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Target and trajectory double-checked and recorded.
Recorded borders agree with imaging.
Impedances normal and programme saved.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術中巨刺激測試
steps.objective: 測試療效與副作用閾值以確認最佳位置。
steps.objectiveEn: Test benefit and side-effect thresholds to confirm the optimal position.
steps.instruction: 以 130 Hz、60 µs 遞增電流，觀察僵硬／顫抖改善與副作用（內囊：肌肉收縮；內側丘系：持續麻木；動眼：複視）。
steps.instructionEn: Increase current at 130 Hz/60 µs; observe rigidity/tremor improvement and side effects (capsule: contractions; lemniscus: persistent paraesthesia; oculomotor: diplopia).
steps.observation: 記錄治療窗（療效閾值到副作用閾值）。
steps.observationEn: Record the therapeutic window (benefit to side-effect threshold).
steps.failure: 治療窗 < 1–1.5 mA 代表電極過近鄰近結構，應調整。
steps.failureEn: A window < 1–1.5 mA suggests proximity to neighbouring structures; reposition.
steps.check: 治療窗充足且無持續副作用。
steps.checkEn: Adequate window without persistent side effects.

knowledge.title: 副作用定位學
knowledge.text: 每種副作用對應一個方向的鄰近結構，是校正電極的指南針。
knowledge.textEn: Each side effect maps to a neighbouring structure in one direction and acts as a compass for correction.

quiz.question: 「術中巨刺激測試」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Intra-operative macrostimulation testing'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
治療窗充足且無持續副作用。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Adequate window without persistent side effects.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 永久電極置入與固定
steps.objective: 置入永久電極並固定於顱骨。
steps.objectiveEn: Place the permanent lead and anchor it to the skull.
steps.instruction: 在 X 光下更換為永久電極，以固定裝置鎖定，拍攝確認無移位；兩側重複。
steps.instructionEn: Exchange for the permanent lead under fluoroscopy, lock the anchoring device and image to confirm no displacement; repeat on the other side.
steps.observation: 記錄電極型號、序號與接點深度。
steps.observationEn: Record lead model, serial number and contact depths.
steps.failure: 固定時電極回縮數毫米是常見失誤，固定後需再次影像確認。
steps.failureEn: Lead retraction by millimetres during fixation is a common error; re-image after locking.
steps.check: 影像顯示電極位置與測試位置一致。
steps.checkEn: Imaging shows the lead where it was tested.

knowledge.title: 方向性電極
knowledge.text: 分段接點可將電流導向，擴大治療窗。
knowledge.textEn: Segmented contacts steer current and widen the therapeutic window.

quiz.question: 「永久電極置入與固定」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Permanent lead implantation and fixation'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
影像顯示電極位置與測試位置一致。
治療窗充足且無持續副作用。
導引管位置經 X 光／O-arm 確認。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Imaging shows the lead where it was tested.
Adequate window without persistent side effects.
Cannula position confirmed on fluoroscopy/O-arm.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 延長線、脈衝產生器植入與初始程控
steps.titleEn: Extension, pulse generator implantation and initial programming
steps.objective: 植入 IPG 並完成系統阻抗測試與初始設定。
steps.objectiveEn: Implant the IPG, test impedances and set initial parameters.
steps.instruction: 鎖骨下囊袋，隧道化延長線，測試各接點阻抗（500–1500 Ω）；初始多在術後數週腦水腫消退後開機，常用 1–2 mA、60 µs、130 Hz。
steps.instructionEn: Infraclavicular pocket, tunnelled extensions, impedance check (500–1500 Ω); switch on usually weeks later once oedema settles, typically 1–2 mA, 60 µs, 130 Hz.
steps.observation: 記錄阻抗與程式。
steps.observationEn: Record impedances and programme.
steps.failure: 開路／短路阻抗代表接線問題，需在關閉傷口前解決。
steps.failureEn: Open/short impedances indicate a connection fault to fix before closure.
steps.check: 系統阻抗正常、程式已儲存。
steps.checkEn: Impedances normal and programme saved.

knowledge.title: 術後程控
knowledge.text: 單極掃描找出每個接點的治療窗，再逐步減藥。
knowledge.textEn: Monopolar review finds each contact's window before stepwise medication reduction.

quiz.question: 「延長線、脈衝產生器植入與初始程控」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Extension, pulse generator implantation and initial programming'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
系統阻抗正常、程式已儲存。
靶點與軌跡經雙人核對並記錄。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Impedances normal and programme saved.
Target and trajectory double-checked and recorded.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
記錄的核團邊界與影像一致。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Recorded borders agree with imaging.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
影像顯示電極位置與測試位置一致。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Imaging shows the lead where it was tested.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出深部腦刺激手術的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Deep brain stimulation and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
配準誤差在容許範圍。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Registration error within tolerance.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
導引管位置經 X 光／O-arm 確認。
影像顯示電極位置與測試位置一致。
記錄的核團邊界與影像一致。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Cannula position confirmed on fluoroscopy/O-arm.
Imaging shows the lead where it was tested.
Recorded borders agree with imaging.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 靶點與軌跡經雙人核對並記錄。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Target and trajectory double-checked and recorded.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

sources.title: AANS · American Association of Neurological Surgeons

title: DBS 術後程控與參數調整

stages.title: 第一節 · 原理與適應症（免費試學）

steps.title: 原理與適應症
steps.objective: 說明DBS 術後程控與參數調整的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where DBS post-operative programming applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：單極／雙極掃描、幅度・脈寬・頻率三參數、方向性電極與副作用閾值的系統性調整。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: Monopolar/bipolar review, amplitude–pulse-width–frequency titration, directional leads and side-effect thresholds.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: 單極／雙極掃描、幅度・脈寬・頻率三參數、方向性電極與副作用閾值的系統性調整。
knowledge.textEn: Monopolar/bipolar review, amplitude–pulse-width–frequency titration, directional leads and side-effect thresholds.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

quiz.question: 「原理與適應症」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Principles and indications'?
options: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
已正確完成「方向性電極與副作用閾值的系統性調整」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
'directional leads and side-effect thresholds' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制
knowledge.text: 校正、對照與記錄是結果可信的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

quiz.question: 「器材、環境與安全準備」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Equipment, environment and safety preparation'?
options: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
準備清單完成。
已正確完成「幅度・脈寬・頻率三參數」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
optionsEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Preparation checklist complete.
'amplitude–pulse-width–frequency titration' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: DBS 術後程控與參數調整的操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of DBS post-operative programming.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：單極／雙極掃描
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「單極／雙極掃描」在DBS 術後程控與參數調整中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Monopolar/bipolar review' within DBS post-operative programming, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「單極／雙極掃描」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Monopolar/bipolar review': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「單極／雙極掃描」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Monopolar/bipolar review'.
steps.failure: 若「單極／雙極掃描」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Monopolar/bipolar review' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「單極／雙極掃描」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Monopolar/bipolar review' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「單極／雙極掃描」是DBS 術後程控與參數調整的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Monopolar/bipolar review' is a core component of DBS post-operative programming; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：單極／雙極掃描」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Monopolar/bipolar review'?
options: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
準備清單完成。
已正確完成「幅度・脈寬・頻率三參數」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「單極／雙極掃描」並以文字或數據留下證據。

steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。

steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。

steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制

knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: 立體定位頭架與無框架導航的操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: Hands-on elements of Stereotactic frame and frameless navigation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：Leksell 頭架座標
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「Leksell 頭架座標」在立體定位頭架與無框架導航中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Leksell frame coordinates' within Stereotactic frame and frameless navigation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「Leksell 頭架座標」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Leksell frame coordinates': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「Leksell 頭架座標」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'Leksell frame coordinates'.
steps.failure: 若「Leksell 頭架座標」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Leksell frame coordinates' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「Leksell 頭架座標」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Leksell frame coordinates' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「Leksell 頭架座標」是立體定位頭架與無框架導航的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Leksell frame coordinates' is a core component of Stereotactic frame and frameless navigation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：Leksell 頭架座標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

判讀有依據且下一步明確。
準備清單完成。
已正確完成「Leksell 頭架座標」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.
The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
Preparation checklist complete.
'Leksell frame coordinates' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.checkEn: 'CT/MRI fusion and robot-assisted trajectories with their error sources' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.
steps.observation: 寫下判讀句與下一步。
steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。
knowledge.textEn: A result's meaning depends on the probability before the test.

quiz.question: 「判讀與臨床決策」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Interpretation and decision-making'?
options: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
已正確完成「CT／MRI 融合與機器人輔助軌跡的誤差來源」並以文字或數據留下證據。
準備清單完成。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
optionsEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'CT/MRI fusion and robot-assisted trajectories with their error sources' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

Can name three error sources and their prevention.

steps.title: 品質、錯誤與安全回顧
steps.objective: 回顧常見錯誤與安全事件。
steps.objectiveEn: Review common errors and safety events.
steps.instruction: 列出前分析／分析／後分析（或操作前中後）的錯誤來源與預防。
steps.instructionEn: List pre-analytical/analytical/post-analytical (or before/during/after) error sources and prevention.
steps.observation: 完成一份自我檢核表。
steps.observationEn: Complete a self-audit checklist.
steps.failure: 多數錯誤發生在操作前後而非操作中。
steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。
knowledge.textEn: No-blame reporting drives system improvement.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出迷走神經刺激的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Vagus nerve stimulation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
同意書與查核表完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
同意書與查核表完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依迷走神經刺激的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Vagus nerve stimulation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 迷走神經刺激的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Vagus nerve stimulation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定」在迷走神經刺激中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression' within Vagus nerve stimulation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression'.
steps.failure: 若「藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定」是迷走神經刺激的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression' is a core component of Vagus nerve stimulation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出迷走神經刺激的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Vagus nerve stimulation and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
已正確完成「藥物難治性癲癇與憂鬱症的頸部迷走神經電極植入與參數設定」並以文字或數據留下證據。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
'Cervical vagus electrode implantation and settings for drug-resistant epilepsy and depression' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

sources.title: AANS · American Association of Neurological Surgeons

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出反應式神經刺激的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Responsive neurostimulation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：閉迴路偵測癲癇樣放電並即時刺激的顱內裝置。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Closed-loop intracranial device that detects epileptiform activity and stimulates in real time.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依反應式神經刺激的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Responsive neurostimulation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 反應式神經刺激的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Responsive neurostimulation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：閉迴路偵測癲癇樣放電並即時刺激的顱內裝置
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Closed-loop intracranial device that detects epileptiform activity and stimulates in real time
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「閉迴路偵測癲癇樣放電並即時刺激的顱內裝置」在反應式神經刺激中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Closed-loop intracranial device that detects epileptiform activity and stimulates in real time' within Responsive neurostimulation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「閉迴路偵測癲癇樣放電並即時刺激的顱內裝置」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Closed-loop intracranial device that detects epileptiform activity and stimulates in real time': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「閉迴路偵測癲癇樣放電並即時刺激的顱內裝置」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Closed-loop intracranial device that detects epileptiform activity and stimulates in real time'.
steps.failure: 若「閉迴路偵測癲癇樣放電並即時刺激的顱內裝置」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Closed-loop intracranial device that detects epileptiform activity and stimulates in real time' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「閉迴路偵測癲癇樣放電並即時刺激的顱內裝置」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Closed-loop intracranial device that detects epileptiform activity and stimulates in real time' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「閉迴路偵測癲癇樣放電並即時刺激的顱內裝置」是反應式神經刺激的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Closed-loop intracranial device that detects epileptiform activity and stimulates in real time' is a core component of Responsive neurostimulation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：閉迴路偵測癲癇樣放電並即時刺激的顱內裝置」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Closed-loop intracranial device that detects epileptiform activity and stimulates in real time'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
已正確完成「閉迴路偵測癲癇樣放電並即時刺激的顱內裝置」並以文字或數據留下證據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
'Closed-loop intracranial device that detects epileptiform activity and stimulates in real time' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
已正確完成「閉迴路偵測癲癇樣放電並即時刺激的顱內裝置」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
'Closed-loop intracranial device that detects epileptiform activity and stimulates in real time' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出反應式神經刺激的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Responsive neurostimulation and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

sources.title: AANS · American Association of Neurological Surgeons

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出立體定位腦電圖的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Stereo-electroencephalography.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：多支深部電極定位癲癇發作起始區的規劃、植入與判讀。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Planning, implanting and interpreting multiple depth electrodes to localise the seizure-onset zone.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「多支深部電極定位癲癇發作起始區的規劃」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'Planning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
