optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'Identifying the offending vessel' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：Teflon 墊片置入與半面痙攣的應用
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: Teflon interposition and application to hemifacial spasm
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「Teflon 墊片置入與半面痙攣的應用」在顯微血管減壓術中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Teflon interposition and application to hemifacial spasm' within Microvascular decompression for trigeminal neuralgia, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「Teflon 墊片置入與半面痙攣的應用」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Teflon interposition and application to hemifacial spasm': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「Teflon 墊片置入與半面痙攣的應用」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Teflon interposition and application to hemifacial spasm'.
steps.failure: 若「Teflon 墊片置入與半面痙攣的應用」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Teflon interposition and application to hemifacial spasm' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「Teflon 墊片置入與半面痙攣的應用」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Teflon interposition and application to hemifacial spasm' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「Teflon 墊片置入與半面痙攣的應用」是顯微血管減壓術的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Teflon interposition and application to hemifacial spasm' is a core component of Microvascular decompression for trigeminal neuralgia; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：Teflon 墊片置入與半面痙攣的應用」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: Teflon interposition and application to hemifacial spasm'?
options: 已正確完成「責任血管辨識」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「Teflon 墊片置入與半面痙攣的應用」並以文字或數據留下證據。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: 'Identifying the offending vessel' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'Teflon interposition and application to hemifacial spasm' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 已正確完成「Teflon 墊片置入與半面痙攣的應用」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: 'Teflon interposition and application to hemifacial spasm' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出顯微血管減壓術的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Microvascular decompression for trigeminal neuralgia and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
已正確完成「Teflon 墊片置入與半面痙攣的應用」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
'Teflon interposition and application to hemifacial spasm' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
同意書與查核表完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

sources.title: AANS · American Association of Neurological Surgeons

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出脊髓刺激的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Spinal cord stimulation.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
同意書與查核表完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依脊髓刺激的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Spinal cord stimulation.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
已正確完成「慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
'Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 脊髓刺激的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Spinal cord stimulation.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入」在脊髓刺激中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain' within Spinal cord stimulation, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain'.
steps.failure: 若「慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入」是脊髓刺激的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain' is a core component of Spinal cord stimulation; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
已正確完成「慢性神經病變性疼痛的硬膜外電極試驗與植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
'Epidural lead trial and implantation for chronic neuropathic pain' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
同意書與查核表完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出脊髓刺激的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Spinal cord stimulation and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

sources.title: AANS · American Association of Neurological Surgeons

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出鞘內藥物幫浦的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Intrathecal baclofen pump.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入、劑量滴定與再填充。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Pump implantation, titration and refills for severe spasticity.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 已正確完成「嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: 'Pump implantation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'Pump implantation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依鞘內藥物幫浦的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Intrathecal baclofen pump.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 鞘內藥物幫浦的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Intrathecal baclofen pump.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」在鞘內藥物幫浦中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Pump implantation' within Intrathecal baclofen pump, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Pump implantation': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Pump implantation'.
steps.failure: 若「嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Pump implantation' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Pump implantation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」是鞘內藥物幫浦的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Pump implantation' is a core component of Intrathecal baclofen pump; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Pump implantation'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'Pump implantation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：劑量滴定與再填充
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: titration and refills for severe spasticity
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「劑量滴定與再填充」在鞘內藥物幫浦中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'titration and refills for severe spasticity' within Intrathecal baclofen pump, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「劑量滴定與再填充」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'titration and refills for severe spasticity': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「劑量滴定與再填充」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'titration and refills for severe spasticity'.
steps.failure: 若「劑量滴定與再填充」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'titration and refills for severe spasticity' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「劑量滴定與再填充」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'titration and refills for severe spasticity' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「劑量滴定與再填充」是鞘內藥物幫浦的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'titration and refills for severe spasticity' is a core component of Intrathecal baclofen pump; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：劑量滴定與再填充」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: titration and refills for severe spasticity'?
options: 已正確完成「嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
已正確完成「劑量滴定與再填充」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: 'Pump implantation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
'titration and refills for severe spasticity' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
同意書與查核表完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出鞘內藥物幫浦的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Intrathecal baclofen pump and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「嚴重痙攣的鞘內給藥幫浦植入」並以文字或數據留下證據。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'Pump implantation' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

sources.title: AANS · American Association of Neurological Surgeons

title: MR 導引聚焦超音波丘腦切開術

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出MR 導引聚焦超音波丘腦切開術的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of MR-guided focused ultrasound thalamotomy.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：無創熱消融治療原發性顫抖：顱骨密度比、溫度監控與副作用。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Incisionless thermal ablation for essential tremor: skull density ratio, thermometry and adverse effects.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
已正確完成「溫度監控與副作用」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
'thermometry and adverse effects' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
同意書與查核表完整。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Consent and checklist are complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依MR 導引聚焦超音波丘腦切開術的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for MR-guided focused ultrasound thalamotomy.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: MR 導引聚焦超音波丘腦切開術的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of MR-guided focused ultrasound thalamotomy.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：顱骨密度比
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「顱骨密度比」在MR 導引聚焦超音波丘腦切開術中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'skull density ratio' within MR-guided focused ultrasound thalamotomy, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「顱骨密度比」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'skull density ratio': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「顱骨密度比」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'skull density ratio'.
steps.failure: 若「顱骨密度比」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'skull density ratio' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「顱骨密度比」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'skull density ratio' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「顱骨密度比」是MR 導引聚焦超音波丘腦切開術的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'skull density ratio' is a core component of MR-guided focused ultrasound thalamotomy; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：顱骨密度比」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: skull density ratio'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
已正確完成「顱骨密度比」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
'skull density ratio' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：溫度監控與副作用
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: thermometry and adverse effects
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「溫度監控與副作用」在MR 導引聚焦超音波丘腦切開術中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'thermometry and adverse effects' within MR-guided focused ultrasound thalamotomy, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「溫度監控與副作用」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'thermometry and adverse effects': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「溫度監控與副作用」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'thermometry and adverse effects'.
steps.failure: 若「溫度監控與副作用」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'thermometry and adverse effects' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「溫度監控與副作用」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'thermometry and adverse effects' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「溫度監控與副作用」是MR 導引聚焦超音波丘腦切開術的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'thermometry and adverse effects' is a core component of MR-guided focused ultrasound thalamotomy; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：溫度監控與副作用」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: thermometry and adverse effects'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「顱骨密度比」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「溫度監控與副作用」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
'skull density ratio' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'thermometry and adverse effects' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
已正確完成「溫度監控與副作用」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
'thermometry and adverse effects' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出MR 導引聚焦超音波丘腦切開術的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of MR-guided focused ultrasound thalamotomy and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「顱骨密度比」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'skull density ratio' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

sources.title: AANS · American Association of Neurological Surgeons
維基百科（中文）
sources.url: https://zh.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=MR 導引聚焦超音波丘腦切開術

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出周邊神經修復與移植的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Peripheral nerve repair and grafting.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：神經外膜縫合、腓腸神經移植與神經轉位。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Epineurial repair, sural nerve grafting and nerve transfers.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
已正確完成「神經外膜縫合」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
'Epineurial repair' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 已正確完成「神經外膜縫合」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: 'Epineurial repair' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
同意書與查核表完整。
已正確完成「神經外膜縫合」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Consent and checklist are complete.
